'''Edrinu Zaya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. At some point she became part of the [[Order of Revan]] and defected from the Republic, joining with the Revanite forces on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi's]] [[Sky Ridge Island]] under command of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Milenec]]. However, she became disillusioned with the new cause after realizing that the Revanites' ranks included the Empire's worst butchers. Betraying the Revanites, she asked a Republic agent infiltrating their camp to kill Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] [[Raygus Mol]], as man responsible for the burning of [[New Drev'starn]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Zaya appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
